name: command-tabs
title: Command Tabs
description: A package manager switcher that shows the same command for npm, pnpm, yarn and bun, with a copy button. The chosen manager is remembered and shared by every instance on the page.
notes: type="dlx" prefixes npx, pnpm dlx, yarn dlx or bunx --bun. type="install" prefixes npm install, pnpm add, yarn add or bun add.
Pass commands, a record keyed by npm, pnpm, yarn and bun, to write each command out yourself. The last choice is saved in localStorage under lantern-package-manager.
